name: Uldum
summary: Uldum is a massive, sealed Titan research installation tucked behind colossal stone gates in the southernmost cliffs of Tanaris. Long hidden away behind ancient wards and forgotten machinery, it remains inaccessible to modern explorers.

sections.title: The Gates of the Makers
sections.body: Carved into the rugged southern mountain range bordering the Tanaris desert, the monumental gateway to Uldum stands silent and impassable. Built during the ordering of ancient Kalimdor, the compound served as an advanced Titan facility tied to their mysterious efforts to shape and oversee the planet's biosphere. Titanic wardens and defensive constructs once maintained the perimeter, leaving modern mortals only monumental stone carved arches and buried secrets that have defied all mundane attempts at entry.

sections.title: The Sealed Secrets
sections.body: The site's unmistakable Titan craftsmanship draws the curiosity of dwarven scholars, yet no mechanism or key has been found that might unlock the ancient complex. Legend claims that true insight into the secrets locked within requires the lost Plates of Uldum, leaving the dwarven scholars peering through the keyhole of an empire they cannot yet breach.

faq.q: Can you open the gates to Uldum?
faq.answer: No. The massive stone gates leading into the mountain pass are completely sealed and shut fast against any mortal intrusion. No mechanism or key exists in the surrounding desert to unlock them.

According to ancient records and Titan lore, Uldum is a vast research facility constructed by the Titans to study and enhance the biosphere of Azeroth. However, exact details remain locked away behind Titan security measures.

faq.q: What are the Plates of Uldum?
faq.answer: The Plates of Uldum are ancient data discs created by the Titans. According to lore preserved by ancient stone keepers, specific knowledge regarding the work and facilities inside Uldum can only be accessed through these sacred plates.

angles.text: For dwarves pursuing their Titan heritage through the Explorers' League, the colossal gates of Uldum represent one of the greatest uncracked mysteries on the continent of Kalimdor.
Alliance scholars hope to beat any rival power to whatever Titan secrets lie concealed in the southern mountains.
